links.comparator_used: Free-text JSON prompt with post-hoc parsing and retry
links.outcome: First-pass JSON/schema validity of admission-note editing outputs
links.effect: Schema enforcement: all models produced 70 of 70 first-pass valid, schema-compliant outputs in every run; free-text JSON prompt: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 had 74.3-78.6% first-pass validity per run and 18.6-21.4% persistent parse/schema failures after retry
links.tradeoff: Schema enforcement did not eliminate model-specific editing behavior; models still differed in verbosity and numeric-token preservation.
links.quote: Under schema enforcement, all models produced 70 of 70 first-pass valid, schema-compliant outputs in every run.

links.comparator_used: Embedding system instructions in the user message (Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct)
links.effect: Separate system/user roles: 12/700 (1.7%) invalid vs. embedded in user message: 55/700 (7.9%)
links.quote: In a message-format sensitivity analysis using Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct, embedding system instructions in the user message increased first-attempt invalid outputs compared with separate system/user roles (55/700, 7.9% vs. 12/700, 1.7%).
